item.title: Generic class new doesn't infer type var for instance var
item.author: 2f1cafc
item.content:encoded: When is defined like this:class Foo(T) def initialize(@value : T); end end the following works fine as a local var, which matches the description in the Generics section of the spec:x = Foo.new("hello") # Foo(String).new inferred However when is an instance variable, it doesn’t work:class Bar @x = Foo.new("hello") # compile error: cannot infer type of @x end Instead I have to write @x = Foo(String).new("hello") . Is this a bug?

item.title: Accessing Google APIs via Crystal
item.author: nbrandaleone
item.content:encoded: I work with Google Cloud often, and typically use Ruby to interface with the APIs. Ruby is an official SDK of Google Cloud. However, I prefer these days to things in Crystal if possible (it is all about speed!). However, crystal is not an official SDK of Google.Well, I was able to write a generator that creates crystal shards from the Google Discovery docs (similar to openSDK specs). This is similar to how almost all the official languages are generated these days. The most recent language (Rust) acknowledges this in the README.At the moment, there is only one library generated (Cloud Storage), but I am working on generating all the SDKs. Of course, when I say I wrote the code, I really meant that I worked with an AI tool to create it. Thus, it is not idiomatic - but it works… :-)

item.title: Announcing krikri - An Ansible compatible engine written in Crystal
item.author: weirdbricks
item.content:encoded: I absolutely love Ansible and wanted to see if I could get AI to rewrite it in Crystal and if it could make it faster.It’s 2 times faster on cold runs than Ansible and about 7 times faster on warm runs. I also compared against Mitogen: 1.3 times faster on cold runs and about 3 times faster on warm runs.I’ve tested it against thousands of existing Ansible roles from Ansible galaxy to ensure compatibility.There’s obviously some things that krikri doesn’t support like all the custom Python plugins, inventory plugins and community modules.
